title: Quantity
description: A measurable dimension (temperature, hardness, precision...) with a unit and optional ballpark bands.

scale.description: ordinal = only order is meaningful (Mohs); ratio = arithmetic is meaningful.

bands.description: Contiguous ballpark bands, smallest first. min is inclusive, max is exclusive.

wikidata.description: Where Wikidata holds this quantity: the property (P1088 for Mohs hardness) and the unit its values must be in. Things crosswalked to Wikidata take their value from it (ADR 0043); a value in another unit fails the build rather than be read as ours.

unit.description: The Wikidata item of the unit, such as Q199 ("1", no unit) for Mohs.
